beta.notes:
New in this version:
• Work Sample Buddy can now connect a Google Drive source in one step, match samples by district ID, stamp assignment details during import, and let you choose or revisit which artifact fills a work-sample slot.
• Samples can now be re-filed under a different class, and workspaces from a previous school year display a warning before you continue.

Fixes:
• Fixed PCA roster sync failing with a database uniqueness error when requirements from another school year already existed.
• When folder and school-year setup opens an empty matrix, Work Sample Buddy now offers to request a roster sync from the PCA Chrome Extension.
• Fixed parked or unmatched sample candidates being counted incorrectly, becoming unreachable, or being dropped instead of offered for review.
• Fixed Drive refresh crashes and cases where choosing Keep Selected, Review Alternatives, or moving a sample did nothing or lost the selected artifact.
• Fixed Schoology full sync retrying indefinitely and reduced database work that could freeze the main window during sync or matrix refresh.

stable.notes:
Fixes:
• Fixed the sample verification window reporting "All fields verified" when the date box was still empty. An automatically read date was stamped on the sample and counted as checked without ever being shown, so it could be saved without anyone seeing it.
